=======================================
JSX attribute names that are reserved words
=======================================

const a = <div class="x" for="y" default="z" />;

---

(program
  (lexical_declaration
    (variable_declarator
      name: (identifier)
      value: (jsx_self_closing_element
        name: (identifier)
        attribute: (jsx_attribute
          (property_identifier)
          (string
            (string_fragment)))
        attribute: (jsx_attribute
          (property_identifier)
          (string
            (string_fragment)))
        attribute: (jsx_attribute
          (property_identifier)
          (string
            (string_fragment)))))))

=======================================
JSX element and member names that are reserved words
=======================================

const b = <Foo.default.return />;
const c = <class />;

---

(program
  (lexical_declaration
    (variable_declarator
      name: (identifier)
      value: (jsx_self_closing_element
        name: (member_expression
          object: (member_expression
            object: (identifier)
            property: (property_identifier))
          property: (property_identifier)))))
  (lexical_declaration
    (variable_declarator
      name: (identifier)
      value: (jsx_self_closing_element
        name: (identifier)))))

=======================================
Optional chaining with reserved words in TSX
=======================================

const d = a?.delete(b) ?? m?.class;

---

(program
  (lexical_declaration
    (variable_declarator
      name: (identifier)
      value: (binary_expression
        left: (call_expression
          function: (member_expression
            object: (identifier)
            optional_chain: (optional_chain)
            property: (property_identifier))
          arguments: (arguments
            (identifier)))
        right: (member_expression
          object: (identifier)
          optional_chain: (optional_chain)
          property: (property_identifier))))))
